name: pob-dzvp-rev2
description:
Basis set: pob-dzvp-rev2
pob-dzvp-rev2: libint's own file, element data unchanged, followed
by the Si, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Ge, As, Se, Br block(s) from the Basis Set Exchange. libint
omits these because they were added to the set by a later and
separate publication, not because the data is in doubt:
  Si, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Ge, As, Se, Br: D. Vilela Oliveira, J. Laun, M. F. Peintinger, T. Bredow, J. Comput. Chem. 40, 2364 (2019); DOI: 10.1002/jcc.26013
Fetched from the basis-set-exchange distribution, catalogue
  version 0.12, on 2026-09-10. No network access involved.
License: numerical parameter data from published scientific
  papers; see docs/license.md section 3a.

Rb-I (16 records, 2026-10-13, #292): valence double-zeta shells with the Stuttgart-Cologne ECPs from the Bredow group's pob-dzvp-rb-i archive (J. Laun, D. Vilela Oliveira, T. Bredow, J. Comput. Chem. 39, 1285 (2018); DOI: 10.1002/jcc.25195), the same potentials block for block as the pob-TZVP and pob-TZVP-rev2 records; CRYSTAL radial powers converted to the Gaussian convention and the local channel emitted (#207).
